plugins.name: fractalwright
plugins.description: Render, explain, measure and animate fractals as reproducible recipes: Mandelbrot, Julia, Burning Ship, Tricorn and Multibrot stills from a recipe JSON or preset with smooth colouring and palettes, box-counting dimension and Mandelbrot area measured against known values, plain explanations of each family. Use whenever the user wants a fractal image or wallpaper, asks 'render a Mandelbrot', 'make a Julia set', 'what is the Burning Ship', 'what is the fractal dimension of this picture', 'measure this coastline', 'fractal palette', or wants to redraw a fractal exactly. Also 'refresh fractalwright'. Not for general shaders (threewright) or pixel art (pixelwright).
